instructions.name: bind_hotkey
docs: A miner links its Solana pubkey to its Bittensor hotkey (stores the hotkey + an sr25519 sig the
validator verifies off-chain). Overwrites in place on re-bind.

accounts.name: miner_state
docs: Present on the miner path (created by `post_collateral`); whitelisted validators have none
and pass the program id in its place (anchor's optional-account None).

accounts.name: hotkey_binding
docs: Set-once reverse marker keyed by the hotkey. `init_if_needed` so the same miner can re-bind; the
handler rejects a different pubkey trying to claim an already-owned hotkey.

instructions.name: bump_vault_generation
docs: Retire the current vault's attestation-epoch namespace when the bond vault is replaced.

instructions.name: close_legacy_initiate_round
docs: The same reap for an initiate `VoteRound` stranded at the retired per-miner address (live
rounds key by swap_key). Rent → caller: rounds were validator-funded, not miner-funded.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone — and also the rent destination: the round was validator-funded, not miner-funded,
so unlike the slots above its rent does not belong to the miner.

accounts.name: vote_round
docs: by swap_key); owner + discriminator verified in the handler.

instructions.name: close_legacy_pool
docs: Permissionless: reap a `Pool` stranded at the retired pre-v3.1 `[pool, miner]` address (the
live seeds carry the backing), refunding rent to the miner. Any historical layout — the
address itself is the legacy proof.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone — the caller only pays the transaction.

accounts.name: miner
docs: address from this key is what proves the two belong together.

accounts.name: pool
docs: seeds), so the derivation is the legacy proof; owner + discriminator verified in the handler.

instructions.name: close_legacy_quote
docs: Permissionless: reap a quote stranded at the pre-W2b derivation, refunding its rent to the
miner that paid it. Cannot touch a live quote (see the handler's address proof).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone — the caller only pays the transaction.

accounts.name: quote
docs: live `MinerQuote` type cannot parse it, so it arrives unchecked.

instructions.name: close_legacy_reservation
docs: The same reap for a `Reservation` stranded at the retired `[resv, miner]` address.

instructions.name: close_legacy_swap
docs: Admin break-glass: decode a pre-v3 (v10-layout, implicitly SOL-backed) `Swap` that survived an
upgrade — undecodable by the live type — reap it (rent → user), and emit its terms so the relay
settles the refund. Unreachable in the normal flow (the migrate drain gate blocks live Swaps).

accounts.name: admin
docs: Admin only — a one-shot recovery run by the migration operator, not a permissionless reap.

accounts.name: miner_state
docs: The miner whose hub the reaped swap froze. Bound by the `miner` arg and re-checked against the
decoded `swap.miner` in the handler, so the caller can't free a different miner's state. Freeing
the SOL hub here is what actually unblocks the miner — reaping the PDA alone leaves it bricked.

instructions.name: close_stale_claim
docs: Permissionless: reap an orphaned `PendingAttestation` claim whose reservation expired (rent →
caller; frees the reservation's claim slot).

instructions.name: close_unfilled_reservation
docs: Permissionless: reap an unfilled reservation past its finalize deadline, freeing the miner.

accounts.name: pool
docs: This hub's pool — read to see whether a live contest already re-armed the busy lock far ahead.
Same (miner, backing) as the reservation; always exists once a contest has ever run on this hub.

instructions.name: confirm_swap
docs: Validators confirm a fulfilled swap (1% fee → treasury; swap closed) on quorum.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: The miner's own collateral vault — the 1% fee is debited from here.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Subnet treasury — the 1% fee moves here out of the miner's collateral vault.

accounts.name: direction_stats
docs: Realized per-direction stats, keyed by the (constrained-to-swap) chain args. Created on the first
completed swap in this direction (validator-funded), reused + accrued thereafter.
Boxed (with `swap`) to keep these String-heavy accounts off the BPF stack.

instructions.name: deactivate
docs: Miner self-deactivation (no consensus). `backing = Some(chain)` drops that purse only; `None`
drops every purse (the full exit).

instructions.name: extend_reservation
docs: A validator slides a reservation's deadline forward while it waits on slow source-chain
confirmation. Bounded by the per-reservation ceiling frozen at creation.

instructions.name: extend_timeout
docs: A validator slides a swap's fulfillment timeout forward while it waits on slow destination-chain
confirmation. Bounded by the per-swap ceiling frozen at creation.

instructions.name: finalize_reservation
docs: The seat winner (`reservation.router`) names the taker + amounts, filling the reservation
(`reserved_until = now + ttl`). Runs the swap-size bounds + collateral gate + the collateral bind.

accounts.name: router
docs: The seat winner. Must equal `reservation.router` (constraint below).

accounts.name: attestation
docs: The bond attestation for the reservation's pinned backing — required for any backing but "sol",
which reads the local vault ledger instead. Seeds bind it to (this miner, that backing).

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Create Config + Treasury with collateral bounds, timeout, consensus threshold,
swap-size bounds, and reservation TTL.

instructions.name: mark_fulfilled
docs: Miner records destination fulfillment (tx hash/block); Active → Fulfilled.

instructions.name: migrate_config
docs: Rewrite the v10 Config into the v12 layout, seeding the W1+W2 fields with their defaults.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Checked against the `admin` stored in the account's raw bytes — the live `Config` type can't
parse a v10 account, so Anchor's `has_one` isn't available here.

instructions.name: migrate_miner_state
docs: Rewrite one v10 MinerState into the v12 layout, carrying the legacy `active` bool into the SOL
activation bit.

accounts.name: config
docs: Parsed as the LIVE type, so this crank can only run once `migrate_config` has already landed —
the ordering the runbook needs, enforced by the account resolver rather than by convention.

instructions.name: open_or_request
docs: A router bids into (or opens) a per-miner reservation-lottery pool for a pair. First caller pins
the miner's on-chain quote; every fresh router pays a flat anti-spam fee to treasury. A bid
carries no taker and no amounts — the seat winner names those in `finalize_reservation`.

accounts.name: router
docs: The router of this request — a whitelisted validator OR a plain user (entry is permissionless).

accounts.name: quote
docs: The miner's standing quote for this pair AND backing — must exist; pinned into the Pool at open.
The backing is a seed, so naming the wrong one lands on a different (usually absent) account
rather than silently bidding against an offer the miner never made.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: The bond attestation for the quote's backing — required for any backing but "sol", which reads
the local vault ledger. Seeds bind it to (this miner, that backing).

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Subnet-revenue sink for the reservation fee (kept separate from the collateral vault).

accounts.name: reservation
docs: The (miner, hub) reservation slot — checked so a new contest can't be opened while THIS hub's
reservation is still active (it would overwrite the winner's hold). Populated by `resolve_pool`.

instructions.name: post_collateral
docs: Miner deposits SOL collateral into the vault.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: The miner's own collateral vault — holds only this miner's collateral lamports.

instructions.name: remove_quote
docs: Miner removes one of its quotes; the PDA is closed and its rent refunded to the miner.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury sink for the remove churn fee — subnet revenue, separate from collateral.

instructions.name: resolve_pool
docs: Permissionless: after the window closes, run the stake-weighted draw and create the winner's
UNFILLED reservation (pins router + miner quote; `reserved_until = 0`).

accounts.name: pool
docs: Self-referential seed: the pool's own pinned backing names its (miner, hub) address, so no
backing argument is needed — the address either matches the stored chain or fails to resolve.

instructions.name: set_attest_max_age
docs: How stale the global attestation heartbeat may get before non-local backings fuse off at entry.

instructions.name: set_halted
docs: Emergency halt: admin toggles the global halt flag (gates deposits / activations /
reservation pools).

instructions.name: set_quote
docs: Miner publishes/overwrites its standing quote for one pair-direction and one backing (the
reverse direction, and the same direction on the other purse, are separate quotes). The backing
must be a hub on one of the legs and already activated for this miner.

accounts.name: miner_state
docs: Seeded by the signer, so the activation check below reads the poster's OWN purses and no other.

accounts.name: treasury
docs: Treasury sink for the quote-update churn fee — subnet revenue, separate from collateral.

instructions.name: set_settlement_grace
docs: How long a non-locally-backed timeout keeps the miner busy while the penalty settles on the
backing chain (busy-until-settled).

instructions.name: set_tao_min_collateral
docs: Attested bond floor for activating the TAO backing, in rao.

instructions.name: set_tao_min_swap_amount
docs: TAO-backed swap bounds, in rao (the lamport pair above is SOL-backed only).

instructions.name: submit_swap_claim
docs: Permissionless: the reservation holder records their source-tx hash on-chain, creating the swap
in `PendingAttestation` (all terms copied from the immutable reservation; no miner obligation).

accounts.name: swap
docs: Boxed (String-heavy) to keep it off the BPF stack.

instructions.name: timeout_swap
docs: Validators time out an overdue swap (slash → user refund; swap closed) on quorum.

accounts.name: collateral_vault
docs: The miner's own collateral vault — the slash is debited from here.

instructions.name: vote_activate
docs: A validator votes to activate one of a miner's backings ("sol" | "tao"); its bit is set on quorum.

accounts.name: vote_round
docs: The round is keyed per miner (not per backing) — one activation proposal at a time, with the
backing carried in the bound hash.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: Required for an off-chain backing, omitted for "sol" (which reads the local vault ledger).

instructions.name: vote_attest_heartbeat
docs: A validator bumps the global attestation heartbeat; on quorum it advances to the chain's clock.
While it is stale, entry into any non-locally-backed swap is fused off.

instructions.name: vote_deactivate
docs: A validator votes to force-deactivate one of a miner's backings; its bit is cleared on quorum.

instructions.name: vote_initiate
docs: Validators attest a pending claim (`PendingAttestation` → `Active` on quorum); the miner's
obligation deadline starts here.

accounts.name: vote_round
docs: Keyed by swap_key like the confirm/timeout rounds (v3.1): per-hub for free (a swap pins its
backing), and closable at quorum since the unique seed is never reused.

accounts.name: swap
docs: The claim-created swap (must be `PendingAttestation`). Boxed (String-heavy) off the BPF stack.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: The bond attestation for the swap's pinned backing — required for any backing but "sol".

instructions.name: vote_set_attestation
docs: A validator attests a miner's effective bond on one backing chain; written on quorum. The full
payload is hash-bound, so divergent attestations conflict instead of co-counting.

accounts.name: miner_state
docs: Read for this hub's in-flight-swap reserve — a downward write is refused only if it would drop
the purse below a LIVE obligation (F5). Every attestable miner is registered, so this always exists.

accounts.name: reservation
docs: obligation the bond must still cover (`vote_initiate` re-checks it), so it floors a downward write
— but a mere open pool carries NO obligation and must not, else it can be spammed to keep a
just-slashed bond advertised stale-high (F5 #4). May be uninitialized; handled in the handler.

accounts.name: attestation
docs: One-time rent per (miner, hub), paid by whichever validator's vote reaches quorum first.

accounts.name: vote_round
docs: Reusable per-(miner, chain) round — one bond, one open proposal at a time.

instructions.name: vote_set_weights
docs: A validator submits the full weight vector (index-aligned to `Config.validators`) plus
`round_key` = the snapshot hash, which keys the vote-round PDA (competing proposals coexist);
on quorum the weights are saved. Validators read stake off-chain and converge on one snapshot.

instructions.name: withdraw_collateral
docs: Miner withdraws SOL collateral (subject to inactive / no-swap / cooldown guards).

instructions.name: withdraw_treasury
docs: Admin withdraws accrued protocol fees from the treasury PDA to a recipient.

accounts.name: recipient
docs: fees to an arbitrary address; onward distribution is a second, admin-signed hop.

types.name: AttestHeartbeat
docs: The global attestation heartbeat advanced (the dead-man fuse's liveness signal).

types.name: Binding
docs: Per-miner identity binding (`seeds = [BIND_SEED, miner]`): links a miner's Solana pubkey to its
Bittensor hotkey. `hotkey_sig` is an sr25519 signature by the hotkey over the miner's Solana pubkey;
the contract only STORES it (sr25519 verify is too costly on-chain) — the validator verifies it
off-chain. This PDA enforces pubkey→≤1 hotkey structurally; the reverse (hotkey→≤1 pubkey) is enforced
by the `HotkeyBinding` marker below. The miner may re-bind in place (refresh sig / change hotkey).

fields.name: miner
docs: The miner's Solana pubkey (== seed; stored for `getProgramAccounts` convenience).

fields.name: hotkey
docs: Bittensor hotkey (sr25519 public key).

fields.name: hotkey_sig
docs: sr25519 signature by `hotkey` over the miner pubkey — validator-verified off-chain.

fields.name: bound_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the last (re)bind (staleness signal for off-chain consumers).

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

types.name: BondAttestation
docs: A miner's bond on one backing chain, as asserted by validator quorum
(`seeds = [ATTEST_SEED, miner, chain_id]`). This program cannot read the vault holding the bond, so
the quorum writes down what it read — the guards then work off a single agreed snapshot instead of
N private reads that would never agree.

fields.name: miner
docs: The miner this bond belongs to (== seed; stored for `getProgramAccounts` convenience).

fields.name: chain
docs: Backing chain id (== seed), e.g. "tao".

fields.name: effective_balance
docs: EFFECTIVE bond in the backing asset's smallest unit (rao for "tao") = vault gross − accrued fees
− voted-but-unapplied slash verdicts. Debited at verdict time, so it deliberately leads the vault
pessimistically — that is what keeps the 1.1× guards arithmetically true.

fields.name: locked
docs: Whether the bond is locked on the backing chain. An unlocked bond backs nothing.

fields.name: epoch
docs: The vault's monotonic lock epoch. A write at an older epoch is refused, so a stale round can
never restore a lock state the vault has already moved past.

fields.name: attested_at
docs: Quorum timestamp. Observability only — never a guard input (the fuse reads the global heartbeat).

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

types.name: BondAttested
docs: A bond attestation was written by quorum. Absolute figures per the post-total convention — the
reconciler diffs these against the vault without re-reading Solana state.

types.name: CollateralPosted
docs: Collateral events carry the resulting total, not a delta — so a consumer can set an absolute
baseline from one event instead of accumulating from an unknown start. Fee/slash events follow
the same post-total rule.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount added this call (lamports).

fields.name: total
docs: Miner's resulting collateral total after this call (lamports).

types.name: CollateralVault
docs: Per-miner native-SOL collateral vault PDA (`seeds = [COLLATERAL_SEED, miner]`), program-owned.
Each miner's collateral lives in its OWN account — trustless custody (leaves only via the owning
miner's `withdraw_collateral` or a slash to the wronged user) and no shared-vault write contention.
The amount is `MinerState.collateral`; invariant: lamports == rent_exempt + collateral.

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount removed this call (lamports).

fields.name: total
docs: Miner's resulting collateral total after this call (lamports).

types.name: Config
docs: Singleton config PDA (`seeds = [CONFIG_SEED]`). Amounts are in the named asset's smallest unit
(lamports unless the field says otherwise), durations in seconds.

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin authority (treasury withdrawals + config setters).

fields.name: version
docs: On-chain schema version, for upgrade tracking.

fields.name: min_collateral
docs: Minimum collateral a miner must hold to be activatable (lamports).

fields.name: max_collateral
docs: Maximum collateral a miner may post (lamports). 0 = no cap.

fields.name: fulfillment_timeout_secs
docs: Swap fulfillment timeout (seconds); withdrawal cooldown = 2x this.

fields.name: min_swap_amount
docs: Swap-size bounds on the collateral-backed (SOL) amount, in lamports. 0 = unbounded.

fields.name: tao_min_swap_amount
docs: The same bounds for TAO-backed swaps, in rao. Selected by `collateral_chain` — bounds are always
compared in the backing asset's own units, never converted through the rate (that would smuggle
a price oracle into a guard). Each future hub adds its own pair here.

fields.name: tao_min_collateral
docs: Attested effective bond (rao) needed to activate the TAO backing — the rao twin of
`min_collateral`. Each future hub adds its own floor here.

fields.name: settlement_grace_secs
docs: Seconds a miner stays busy after a non-locally-backed timeout, while the penalty settles on the
backing chain (busy-until-settled). Unused by the "sol" path, which settles atomically.

fields.name: last_attest_heartbeat
docs: Unix timestamp of the last `vote_attest_heartbeat` quorum (0 = never). Liveness is a GLOBAL
question, so the fuse reads this one value rather than each attestation's own age — a quiet
miner's old-but-correct attestation is not staleness.

fields.name: attest_max_age_secs
docs: How stale the heartbeat may get before non-locally-backed entry (finalize/initiate) is refused.

fields.name: reservation_ttl_secs
docs: How long a reservation holds a miner exclusive, in seconds.

fields.name: consensus_threshold_percent
docs: Quorum threshold, percent of the whitelisted validator set (e.g. 66).

fields.name: validators
docs: Whitelisted validator set (consensus participants) + draw weights, capped at MAX_VALIDATORS.

fields.name: last_weights_update
docs: Unix timestamp of the last consensus weight update (0 = never). Gates the update cadence floor.

fields.name: halted
docs: Emergency halt: when true, new deposits / activations / reservation pools are rejected.

fields.name: reservation_fee_lamports
docs: Flat anti-spam fee per reservation request, lamports (runtime-tunable; 0 disables).

fields.name: pool_window_secs
docs: Reservation-lottery pooling window, seconds (runtime-tunable).

fields.name: finalize_window_secs
docs: Seconds the seat winner has after the draw to fill (finalize) its reservation before it can be
reaped. Runtime-tunable within [MIN, MAX] (see constants.rs). The internal auction runs here.

fields.name: weights_update_min_interval_secs
docs: Minimum seconds between consensus weight updates (runtime-tunable anti-thrash floor).

fields.name: max_total_extension_secs
docs: Total seconds a reservation/swap deadline may be slid forward, frozen into each at creation as
its `max_extend_at` ceiling. Runtime-tunable within [MIN, MAX] (see constants.rs).

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

fields.name: vault_generation
docs: Which bond vault the attested epochs belong to. Bumped when the vault is replaced: relayers
compose it into the high half of the attestation epoch, so a new vault's epochs outrank every
epoch the retired one could produce and the monotonic guard keeps working across the swap.

types.name: FulfillmentGraceApplied
docs: `mark_fulfilled` slid `timeout_at` forward to cover the destination chain's confirmation window
(so a miner who paid just before the deadline can't be slashed while the tx confirms). Post-value
like every deadline event. Separate from `SwapTimeoutExtended` — no validator is involved.

types.name: HotkeyBinding
docs: Set-once hotkey→pubkey reverse marker (`seeds = [HOTKEY_BIND_SEED, hotkey]`): the first pubkey to bind
a hotkey claims it permanently. A second, different pubkey trying the same hotkey is rejected, so the
strike-dodge (struck pubkey rotates to a fresh one and re-binds the same hotkey) is closed on-chain
rather than relying on every validator's off-chain first-seen pin. Never closed — one tiny rent-funded
marker per identity (bounded by hotkey churn, not per-event).

fields.name: miner
docs: The pubkey that first claimed this hotkey (== the `Binding.miner`); also a reverse lookup.

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

types.name: HotkeyBound
docs: A miner (re)bound its Bittensor hotkey to its Solana pubkey (A5). The sr25519 signature lives on the
`Binding` PDA; the validator verifies it off-chain.

types.name: LegacySwapClosed
docs: A pre-collateral-chain (v10-layout) `Swap` that survived an upgrade was decoded and terminated.
Break-glass only: emits the frozen terms so the off-chain relay reconciles the SOL settlement and
frees the miner through the existing slash path; the undecodable PDA itself is reaped here.

fields.name: collateral_amount
docs: Swap size in lamports (the v10 layout is implicitly SOL-backed).

types.name: MinerActivated
docs: Miner active-state transitions. Emitted so validators can replay the per-instant `active` history for
the crown capacity integral from deterministic logs alone (the `MinerState.active` flag carries no
history). `MinerActivated` fires on `vote_activate` quorum; `MinerDeactivated` on `vote_deactivate`
quorum, self-`deactivate`, or `apply_penalty`'s auto-deactivation (fee/slash dropping collateral
below the minimum — previously silent, which desynced event-driven scorers from chain state).

types.name: MinerBackingChanged
docs: One backing's activation bit flipped (W2). Emitted on EVERY `vote_activate`/`vote_deactivate`
quorum, whereas MinerActivated/MinerDeactivated fire only when the OR view itself changes — so an
event-driven scorer replaying `active` from those two stays exactly as correct as before.

fields.name: enabled
docs: The bit's new state; `active_backings` is the whole mask after this change.

types.name: MinerDirectionStats
docs: A miner's realized per-direction track record (`seeds = [STATS_SEED, miner, from_chain, to_chain]`).
Accrued by `confirm_swap` on quorum (one row per (miner, from_chain, to_chain)); never closed. Lets
the off-chain validator read realized volume + the executed rate via `getProgramAccounts` instead of
a local ledger. Realized VWAP for the direction = `total_to_amount / total_from_amount` (exact
integer math, no on-chain rate-string parse). Both fields are **asset-pure** (from/to in their own
chain's units) — kept deliberately asset-agnostic so the PDA survives split-collateral; the validator
derives any common-unit (SOL-notional) volume off-chain from its price feed, and the at-time notional
stays in the `SwapCompleted` event.

fields.name: completed
docs: Count of completed (confirmed) swaps in this direction.

fields.name: total_from_amount
docs: Sum of the source/destination leg amounts over completed swaps (asset-native units).

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

types.name: MinerQuote
docs: A miner's standing on-chain quote for one pair-direction and one backing
(`seeds = [QUOTE_SEED, miner, from_chain, to_chain, collateral_chain]`).
Replaces the off-chain Bittensor commitment string: the `(from_chain, to_chain)` ordering encodes
direction, so no `counter_rate`. The backing is in the seeds because it is part of the offer, not a
property of the miner: a dual-purse miner posts the same hub↔hub direction twice, once per backing,
at different rates (D2 — one market per pair, mixed by rate). Written by the owning miner
(`set_quote`, overwrites in place); pools pin whatever's current, so staleness is the miner's
problem. Closed + rent-refunded via `remove_quote`.

fields.name: miner
docs: The miner (signer) that owns this quote.

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Chain whose asset backs any swap drawn from this quote ("sol" = the local vault). Validated at
`set_quote` as a hub backing that is one of the two legs, and carried through Pool → Reservation
→ Swap; every collateral guard downstream reads it rather than the pair.

fields.name: miner_from_addr
docs: Where the miner receives the source asset (on `from_chain`).

fields.name: miner_to_addr
docs: Where the miner sends the destination asset (on `to_chain`).

fields.name: rate
docs: Offered rate, canonical 'dest per 1 canonical source' (hub pinned as source) in BOTH direction
PDAs — never per-direction; direction is applied off-chain via `is_reverse`. Fixed-point =
display_rate × RATE_PRECISION (1e18) — exact, no string parse; see constants::RATE_PRECISION.

fields.name: liquidity
docs: Advertised depth in the asset's own units (u128 to cover wei-scale).

fields.name: updated_at
docs: Unix timestamp of the last write (staleness signal for off-chain consumers).

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

types.name: MinerState
docs: Per-miner state PDA (`seeds = [MINER_SEED, miner]`).

fields.name: miner
docs: The miner (hotkey-equivalent) this state belongs to.

fields.name: collateral
docs: Collateral credited to this miner (lamports). Backed 1:1 by lamports in the miner's collateral vault.

fields.name: active
docs: Whether the miner is active on ANY backing — the OR view of `active_backings`, kept so every
pre-W2 read site works unchanged. Never written on its own; see `set_backing`/`clear_backings`.

fields.name: active_backings
docs: Per-backing activation bitmask (`BACKING_BIT_*`). A deficient purse disables only its own
quotes, not the miner (D2).

fields.name: has_active_swap
docs: Whether the miner has an in-flight swap on ANY hub — the OR view of `active_swap_backings`,
written only by `set_swap` (like `active`/`set_backing`), kept so pre-v3.1 readers work unchanged.

fields.name: active_swap_backings
docs: Per-hub in-flight-swap bitmask (`BACKING_BIT_*`): v3.1 allows one live swap PER hub, so the
bool above is no longer the lock — this mask is.

fields.name: busy_until
docs: Per-hub exit locks (unix ts), indexed by backing-bit position (`backing_slot`): open pool, held
reservation, or in-flight swap on that hub. Self-clearing; read by deactivate/withdraw.

fields.name: settling_until
docs: Per-hub ENTRY locks: a non-locally-settled penalty still settling on that hub's backing chain
(0 = clear). Read only by finalize/vote_initiate gates; exit paths never read these.

fields.name: reserved_collateral
docs: Collateral already obligated to in-flight swaps per hub, in the backing's own smallest unit.
Reserved at initiate quorum, released at confirm/timeout — entry gates check net of this.

fields.name: deactivation_at
docs: Unix timestamp of last deactivation (0 = never). Gates the withdrawal cooldown.

fields.name: successful_swaps
docs: Lifetime swaps completed (confirm_swap quorum). Monotonic. Off-chain emissions warm-up gate:
a miner earns nothing until `successful_swaps >= 2`.

fields.name: failed_swaps
docs: Lifetime swaps failed (timeout_swap quorum). Monotonic, never resets. Off-chain strike-out gate:
`failed_swaps > 2` => no emissions (recover by re-registering).

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

types.name: Pool
docs: A reservation-lottery contest for one idle miner (`seeds = [POOL_SEED, miner]`).
Opened by the first router to route a request (pinning the miner's quote for the chosen pair);
later in-window requests must match that pair. `resolve_pool` runs a stake-weighted draw after
`closes_at` and creates the winner's `Reservation`. Keyed per-miner; the account is reused across
contests (`opened_at == 0` = available), reset rather than closed by `resolve_pool`.

fields.name: from_chain
docs: Pinned pair + miner-quote snapshot, copied from the `MinerQuote` PDA at open.

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: The quote's declared backing, pinned at open beside the rate — it is what `resolve_pool` copies
into the Reservation, so the contest and the swap it produces can never disagree about which
purse is on the hook. Late bids must match it (a different backing is a different offer).

fields.name: rate
docs: Canonical rate (see `MinerQuote::rate`); fixed-point = display_rate × RATE_PRECISION (1e18).

fields.name: opened_at
docs: Unix seconds the pool opened (0 = available/empty slot).

fields.name: closes_at
docs: Unix seconds the request window closes; `resolve_pool` is callable after this.

fields.name: seed_slot
docs: Future slot whose SlotHash seeds the draw (pinned at open).

fields.name: requests
docs: Requests this contest (deduped by router), capped at MAX_VALIDATORS.

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

types.name: PoolDrawArmed
docs: The closed pool's draw seed slot has been pinned to a not-yet-produced slot. Re-emitted if that
slot rolls out of SlotHashes before any crank resolves (a stall long enough to lose ~512 slots).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing hub whose contest armed (v3.1, appended last).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: The pinned quote's backing — the contest is for one offer, and which purse is on the hook is
part of that offer. `resolve_pool` copies it straight into the Reservation.

fields.name: winner
docs: The winning router (a validator or a plain user) — the seat winner that may finalize.

fields.name: requests
docs: How many bids contended.

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing hub whose contest resolved (v3.1, appended last).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Which of the direction's quotes was retracted (see `QuoteSet::collateral_chain`).

fields.name: remove_fee
docs: Anti-flashing churn fee paid into the treasury on removal (lamports); 0 once the quote has
stood past the decay window.

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: The quote's declared backing — part of its identity, not a detail: the same miner may stand two
quotes on one direction at different rates, and only this tells them apart in the log.

fields.name: rate
docs: Fixed-point rate = display_rate × RATE_PRECISION (1e18).

fields.name: update_fee
docs: Anti-flashing churn fee paid into the treasury this call (lamports); 0 on first creation
and once a quote has stood past the decay window.

types.name: Request
docs: One bid into a reservation lottery `Pool`. A bid is JUST the router competing for the seat — no
taker, no amounts. The winner names the fill later via `finalize_reservation`. The miner quote is
the pool's pinned snapshot, not per-request.

fields.name: router
docs: The account that routed this bid — a whitelisted validator OR a plain user (entry is
permissionless). Also the lottery weight key (0 if not whitelisted) and the dedup key.

types.name: Reservation
docs: Confirmed reservation for a miner (`seeds = [RESV_SEED, miner]`).
Created UNFILLED by `resolve_pool` (lottery draw: pins `router` + miner quote, `reserved_until = 0`);
filled by `finalize_reservation` (the winning router names the taker + amounts, sets `reserved_until`);
consumed by `vote_initiate` or reaped (`close_unfilled_reservation` / expiry).
`reserved_until`: 0 = unfilled OR empty, >= now = active, 0 < it < now = expired (overwritable).
`from_addr` is kept so initiate can verify the initiating user matches the reserver.

fields.name: router
docs: The seat winner (winning lottery Request's router). The ONLY signer permitted to
`finalize_reservation` (name the fill). Pinned at draw; a bid carries nothing else.

fields.name: from_addr
docs: User's source-chain address (the reserver). Written at finalize.

fields.name: user
docs: Pinned taker + payout address (named at finalize) — copied to the Swap at claim so the
validator-relayed `submit_swap_claim` can't redirect the payout (front-run defense).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Chain whose asset backs this swap ("sol" = the local vault). Pinned at the draw and copied to
the Swap; every collateral guard reads the leg + purse it names, never the pair (D4).

fields.name: collateral_amount
docs: Collateral-backed swap size, in `collateral_chain`'s smallest unit. Bounded by that backing's
Config swap bounds; must equal the leg denominated in it (the finalize bind).

fields.name: from_amount
docs: Off-chain leg amounts in their own assets (u128 to cover wei-scale).

fields.name: miner_from_addr
docs: Pinned miner quote — hash-bound at reserve time. `vote_initiate` MUST honor these (not the
miner's live commitment): closes the rate-swing / deposit-address-theft total-loss bug.

fields.name: rate
docs: Canonical rate (see `MinerQuote::rate`); fixed-point = display_rate × RATE_PRECISION (1e18).

fields.name: created_at
docs: Reservation creation time, unix seconds. The **source-freshness lower bound**: the user's
deposit must be mined after this (a replayed prior-swap deposit predates it → rejected by the
validator's freshness check, which replaces the source `TxMarker`).

fields.name: reserved_until
docs: Expiry, unix seconds (0 = unfilled OR empty). Set by `finalize_reservation` = now + ttl.

fields.name: finalize_by
docs: Fill deadline, unix seconds. Set at draw = now + `finalize_window_secs`. While `reserved_until
== 0 && now > finalize_by` the unfilled reservation may be reaped (`close_unfilled_reservation`).

fields.name: max_extend_at
docs: Absolute ceiling `reserved_until` may be extended to (unix seconds). Frozen at creation =
initial deadline + the Config budget then, so a later retune can't move an in-flight ceiling.

fields.name: claimed_swap_key
docs: The one live claim's swap_key (`[0;32]` = none). Enforces one pending claim per reservation:
set by `submit_swap_claim`, cleared on `vote_initiate` consume / `close_stale_claim` / a new
`resolve_pool`.

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

types.name: ReservationExtended
docs: A validator slid a reservation/swap deadline forward (single-validator, no quorum). Carries the
new deadline (post-value) so consumers set an absolute, not a delta.

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing hub whose reservation slid (v3.1, appended last).

types.name: ReservationFilled
docs: The seat winner filled its reservation: taker + amounts named, `reserved_until` set. Carries the
fill data the indexer needs for `active_reservations` (formerly on `ReservationRequested`).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing hub this fill draws on (v3.1, appended last).

fields.name: requests
docs: Number of bids in the pool after this one.

types.name: StaleClaimClosed
docs: A stale (never-attested, reservation-expired) PendingAttestation claim was reaped.

types.name: Swap
docs: An in-flight swap (`seeds = [SWAP_SEED, swap_key]`, swap_key = keccak(from_tx_hash)).
Created by `vote_initiate` on quorum; closed by `confirm_swap` / `timeout_swap`. Chains/amounts/
miner-quote copied from the immutable Reservation; user-side fields from the hash-bound initiate vote.

fields.name: rate
docs: Canonical rate (see `MinerQuote::rate`); fixed-point = display_rate × RATE_PRECISION (1e18).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing chain, copied from the Reservation at claim and immutable thereafter (`Reservation::
collateral_chain`). `timeout_swap` reads it to know whether the penalty settles locally.

fields.name: collateral_amount
docs: Collateral-backed swap size, collateral-currency smallest unit (SOL lamports) — fee/slash basis.

fields.name: max_extend_at
docs: Absolute ceiling `timeout_at` may be extended to (unix seconds). Frozen at creation =
initial timeout + the Config budget then, so a later retune can't move an in-flight ceiling.

types.name: SwapClaimed
docs: A reservation holder recorded their source-tx hash on-chain (PendingAttestation). No miner
obligation yet — validators attest it via `vote_initiate`.

fields.name: fee
docs: Absolute protocol fee for this swap, in the BACKING asset's smallest unit. For "sol" it is what
actually moved into the treasury (clamped to available collateral); for a backing that settles
elsewhere nothing moved here and this is what that chain's fee ledger owes.

fields.name: from_chain
docs: Direction + realized leg amounts + executed rate, for off-chain per-swap history (so indexers
don't re-read the now-closed Swap). Feeds the realized volume/VWAP track record (A2).

fields.name: rate
docs: Fixed-point executed rate (display_rate × RATE_PRECISION); matches the on-chain u128 (#495).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing chain this swap declared. `fee` above is the absolute protocol fee for the swap; the
pair (backing, fee) is the whole input the fee relay needs to credit the right ledger.

fields.name: to_amount
docs: Emitted so indexers don't re-read the contract for the delivered amount (v2 cleanup).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing hub (v3.1: appended last — one live swap PER hub, so per-miner events are ambiguous
without it; prefix decoders keep working).

types.name: SwapStatus
docs: Swap lifecycle status. `PendingAttestation` = source-tx claim recorded, not yet attested (no miner
obligation). Terminal states (Completed/TimedOut) aren't stored — the Swap PDA is closed on
confirm/timeout. New variant appended last to keep Active/Fulfilled discriminants stable.

types.name: SwapTimedOut
docs: The timeout verdict. Self-contained by design — the slash relay must never reconstruct state, so
every figure here is absolute and the backing says which chain applies it.

fields.name: slash
docs: Collateral slashed locally and refunded to the user (lamports). 0 when the backing settles
off-chain — `penalty`/`reimbursement` are then the figures the backing chain owes.

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing chain this swap declared ("sol" = settled atomically above).

fields.name: penalty
docs: Penalty owed, in the backing asset's smallest unit: 1.10× the swap size, pre-clamp (the purse
holding the bond does the clamping). Absolute, never a delta.

fields.name: reimbursement
docs: Share of `penalty` owed to the wronged user; the surplus (if any) is protocol revenue.

fields.name: payee
docs: Who the backing chain owes `reimbursement`: the user's own address on `collateral_chain`, so
the seizure can be relayed from this event alone. Empty when the backing settles locally —
that refund already moved, to `Swap::user`.

types.name: Treasury
docs: Singleton subnet-revenue treasury PDA (`seeds = [TREASURY_SEED]`), program-owned, admin-withdrawable.
Holds ONLY subnet income — swap-completion fees, requote (anti-flash) fees, reservation fees —
kept entirely separate from collateral. Invariant: treasury.lamports == rent_exempt + total.

fields.name: total
docs: Accrued protocol revenue (lamports), excludes the rent reserve. Drained by `withdraw_treasury`.

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

fields.name: amount
docs: Amount withdrawn this call (lamports).

fields.name: total
docs: Treasury balance remaining after this call (lamports) — post-total per convention.

types.name: UnfilledReservationClosed
docs: An unfilled reservation was reaped after its finalize deadline (miner freed, fee already sunk).

fields.name: collateral_chain
docs: Backing hub whose slot was reaped (v3.1, appended last).

types.name: ValidatorInfo
docs: A whitelisted validator and its draw weight. `weight` (default 1, admin-set) is the
stake-weight seam consumed ONLY by the reservation-lottery draw; consensus stays count-based.

fields.name: count
docs: Number of validators whose weights were set (the full set; read the vector from Config).

types.name: VoteRound
docs: A consensus vote round PDA (`seeds = [VOTE_SEED, &[request_type], target]`).
`bound_hash` binds every voter to identical request params (keccak of the canonical request),
preventing bait-and-switch on requests whose params aren't fully in the seeds (reserve/initiate).

fields.name: bound_hash
docs: keccak-256 of the canonical request params; set by the first voter, checked by the rest.

fields.name: voters
docs: Validators who have voted this round (deduplicated), capped at MAX_VALIDATORS.

fields.name: created_at
docs: Unix timestamp the round opened (0 = empty/available). Used for TTL reset.

fields.name: bump
docs: Stored PDA bump.

constants.name: ATTEST_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a miner's bond attestation on one backing chain
(`seeds = [ATTEST_SEED, miner_pubkey, chain_id]`). One per (miner, hub) — the quorum's assertion
about a bond this program cannot read.

constants.name: BIND_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a miner's hotkey↔pubkey identity binding (`seeds = [BIND_SEED, miner_pubkey]`).

constants.name: COLLATERAL_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a per-miner native-SOL collateral vault (`seeds = [COLLATERAL_SEED, miner]`) —
each miner's collateral in its own account: trustless custody + no shared-vault contention.

constants.name: CONFIG_SEED
docs: PDA seed for the singleton config account (`seeds = [CONFIG_SEED]`).

constants.name: HOTKEY_BIND_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for the set-once hotkey→pubkey reverse marker (`seeds = [HOTKEY_BIND_SEED, hotkey]`).
Enforces hotkey→≤1 pubkey on-chain: a hotkey can be claimed by exactly one pubkey, ever, so a struck
pubkey can't rotate to a fresh one and re-bind the same hotkey to dodge strikes.

constants.name: MINER_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for per-miner state (`seeds = [MINER_SEED, miner_pubkey]`).

constants.name: POOL_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a reservation-lottery pool (`seeds = [POOL_SEED, miner, backing]`) —
one contest slot per (miner, hub) since v3.1.

constants.name: QUOTE_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a miner's standing per-pair quote
(`seeds = [QUOTE_SEED, miner_pubkey, from_chain, to_chain]`).

constants.name: RESV_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a confirmed reservation (`seeds = [RESV_SEED, miner_pubkey, backing]`) —
one slot per (miner, hub) since v3.1, so each hub's contest holds only its own slot.

constants.name: STATS_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a miner's realized per-direction stats
(`seeds = [STATS_SEED, miner_pubkey, from_chain, to_chain]`).

constants.name: SWAP_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a swap (`seeds = [SWAP_SEED, swap_key]`, swap_key = keccak(from_tx_hash)).

constants.name: TREASURY_SEED
docs: PDA seed for the singleton subnet-revenue treasury (`seeds = [TREASURY_SEED]`) — held entirely
separate from the collateral vault so miner collateral is never commingled with subnet income.

constants.name: VOTE_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefix for a consensus vote round
(`seeds = [VOTE_SEED, &[request_type], target_pubkey]`).
